ddl.definition: select "vritti_core"."inventory_item_quants"."inventory_item_id", "vritti_core"."inventory_item_quants"."location_id", CAST(SUM("vritti_core"."inventory_item_quants"."quantity") AS TEXT) as "stocked_quantity", CAST(SUM("vritti_core"."inventory_item_quants"."reserved_quantity") AS TEXT) as "reserved_quantity", CAST(SUM("vritti_core"."inventory_item_quants"."quantity" - "vritti_core"."inventory_item_quants"."reserved_quantity") AS TEXT) as "available_quantity", "vritti_core"."storage_location_configs"."reorder_level" from "vritti_core"."inventory_item_quants" left join "vritti_core"."storage_location_configs" on "vritti_core"."inventory_item_quants"."inventory_item_id" = "vritti_core"."storage_location_configs"."inventory_item_id" AND "vritti_core"."inventory_item_quants"."location_id" = "vritti_core"."storage_location_configs"."location_id" group by "vritti_core"."inventory_item_quants"."inventory_item_id", "vritti_core"."inventory_item_quants"."location_id", "vritti_core"."storage_location_configs"."reorder_level"
